subject: I agree!
author: foxymoxy26
body:
Yes I will have to agree with Bootleg that it was another fab night on Burnout last night and yes I did tell Bootleg I loved him. I do love you Bootylicious as a very good friend but if you want to interpet it differently then who am I to argue with you. Might I say that it will take more than that to make Lee jealous!

The racer with the 500ish rank got 2 evil takedowns on me which I thought was rude. If you have ever played burnout with me you will know I just race to have a laugh - I am usually last and never go for takedowns (they just happen by accident!). He deliberately targeted me every time he was near me. Well, if that makes him a good racer by stealing boost from a poor defenceless woman such as myself, who wasn't even competing, then so be it! That is, after all, part of the game!

Might I add that there is a lot of impatient people out there who rudely flash their seat belts at you to start the race. We had loads of people do that last night and somebody, after racing with us and didn't say a word, said "You lot talk too much - see ya" and rudely left the room. Now, correct me if I'm wrong but isn't the purpose of having a headset and xbox live, is to talk to people?!?!?!?! 

However, as Lee, Bootleg and myself were drinking and somewhat inebriated last night, maybe it was hard to get a word in edge ways!!!!!!!!!!!   

Foxy
